```yaml
name: Infisical Testing

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  DO_NOT_TRACK: "1"
  TURBO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TURBO_TOKEN }}
  TURBO_TEAM: "buildwithfern"
  TURBO_REMOTE_CACHE_TIMEOUT: 60

jobs:
  test-infisical:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install
        uses: ./.github/actions/install

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "20"
          cache: "pnpm"

      - name: Install Infisical CLI
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://download.infisical.com/cli/install.sh | sh
          echo "$HOME/.infisical/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH

      - name: Run Infisical tests
        run: |
          pnpm test --filter=@fern-api/infisical
        env:
          INFISICAL_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.INFISICAL_TOKEN }}
          INFISICAL_ENV: ${{ secrets.INFISICAL_ENV }}
          INFISICAL_PROJECT_ID: ${{ secrets.INFISICAL_PROJECT_ID }}
          INFISICAL_CLIENT_ID: ${{ secrets.INFISICAL_CLIENT_ID }}
          INFISICAL_CLIENT_SECRET: ${{ secrets.INFISICAL_CLIENT_SECRET }}

      - name: Run Infisical E2E tests
        run: |
          pnpm test:ete --filter=@fern-api/infisical
        env:
          INFISICAL_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.INFISICAL_TOKEN }}
          INFISICAL_ENV: ${{ secrets.INFISICAL_ENV }}
          INFISICAL_PROJECT_ID: ${{ secrets.INFISICAL_PROJECT_ID }}
          INFISICAL_CLIENT_ID: ${{ secrets.INFISICAL_CLIENT_ID }}
          INFISICAL_CLIENT_SECRET: ${{ secrets.INFISICAL_CLIENT_SECRET }}
```
